guardrails: none: no citation gate, no critic, fix not forced to need approval
rationale: adservice_cpu rose from 0.288 to 0.872 (+203%, z=+22.89) and adservice_error went from 0 to 0.0208, while its p90 latency, socket count and memory rose only modestly. Almost no other series moved (all other z < 1), so adservice is the only anomalous service, though the traces and service map never include adservice and the logs are empty, so the link to the frontend errors is not directly shown.

proposed_fix.description: Investigate and relieve CPU saturation on adservice: check for a hot loop or heavy requests, restart or scale out adservice replicas, and raise its CPU limits if throttled.
